_doc: The test registry: ONE list of every automated check, read by tools/run-tests.js (run, select, summarise) and checked by `python3 build.py --check` (every tools/*-smoke.js must be here). Fields: id (the file's name without .js), args, needs (src = straight from src/, dist = the built page, runs a build first; playwright = also needs Chromium, skips itself without), secs (a typical run on one core, for planning), desc (what it proves), covers (regular expressions on a changed file's path from the repo root: `--changed` runs the tests whose covers match), flaky (substrings of FAIL lines that are known random failures: the runner reruns such a test once). Add a test: a row here, nothing else. The numbers of checks are not kept here (they drift): the runner counts the PASS lines.
